newsitem.title: USA: Starbucks sees bottled coffee revs rising.
newsitem.headline: Starbucks sees bottled coffee revs rising.

text.p: KENT, Wash., March 6 (Reuter) Starbucks Corp President Orin Smith on Thursday said he thought annual revenues from the company's bottled coffee beverage could eventually exceed $1.0 billion.
The company is preparing for a national rollout this summer of its bottled Frappuccino in a joint venture with PepsiCo Inc.

Speaking at the company's annual shareholders meeting in Kent, Smith said PepsiCo officials were estimating the beverage could bring in revenues of $400 to $500 million in its first full year of national distribution.
For its fiscal year ended in September, Starbucks reported total revenues of $696.5 million.
The Frappuccino product is a 50-50 joint venture between the two companies and any income or losses would be split equally between Starbucks and PepsiCo.
Smith said the product would be available in most major markets in the United States by the end of this year but it would not achieve full national distribution until the end of fiscal 1998.
Smith said he could not predict when the bottled beverage revenues would reach $1.0 billion.
Starbucks and PepsiCo are investing a total of $50 million on production facilities for their bottled coffee beverages during the next two to three years.
